top_choice_rationale: P004 pairs base editing for Liu alone, the achievement most of the committee already includes and whose chemical novelty (a deaminase tethered to a programmable binder, plus an adenine deaminase evolved to act on DNA) is concrete and distinct from the 2020 cleavage prize, with Gray and Winkler's quantitative photo-triggered kinetics showing how protein structure sets electron tunnelling pathways, the physical basis of respiratory and photosynthetic charge transfer. Both parts have clearly attributable discoveries and at most three laureates. I recognise B032 is the weakest-supported part and a late recognition, so P005 follows as the fallback if it cannot stand on its own.
recusal_note: Field proximity to B032: my own work on respiratory-enzyme electron and proton transfer overlaps with Gray and Winkler's electron-transfer research, which could require recusal; no other connection apparent from profile.
